declaredServices: Start packet builder is an observed call boundary, not compiled damage. Used-skill/record/selected-target/range services expose explicit presence controls.

Sequence charge dispatcher and durability functions are counters; they do not prove damage commitment or modern charge consumption. Formula service evaluates current floor(rank/6)+1 kick count and declared diminishing knockback formula; it is not compiled formula interpreter proof.

Category services select ordinary/unique/boss/hireling/player contexts; RNG returns declared integer controls. Source level reads execute literally. Null used skill in do42 is excluded because the routine dereferences it unconditionally.
established: Start prepares one packet and stores total-kicks minus1 only with valid row/usedskill/selected target in melee range; selected missing target clears remaining count.

Each valid selected-target do42 calls charge dispatcher and durability before testing remaining kicks. Positive remaining count decrements and prepares another packet, calls durability again, and rewinds100percent only while further kicks remain.
Last follow-up kick selects category-specific diminishing knockback; initial single kick is marked knockback unconditionally by start24.
limits: No damage/boot/property/charge-consumption/hit-guarantee/block/input/payment/timing or native handler certificate. This is complete older start/do42 control flow with declared services.
Current consume-one/guaranteed-hit policy postdates source and needs a separate identified adapter. Exact per-kick versus per-sequence modern behavior is not settled by this proof.
No copied arithmetic fragment is presented as full kick damage proof. Final visual/audio/icons are independently pending.
